title: When War Arises
description: When war arises, you have to be prepared !
body:
**When War Arises** is a Minecraft mod that enhances your combat experience by adding new defensive gear. 
Equip yourself with some epic **riot shields and taser gun**, prepare for intense battles, and survive in a world where danger is everywhere. Stay ready war doesn’t wait !

**Planned:**
- Stunned effect for Taser Gun
- Bullet hole particles for Taser Gun
- Aiming for Taser Gun
- Custom enchantments for Riot Shields and Taser Gun
